modelOverview: Launched in 2007 in collaboration with Formula 1 driver Felipe Massa, the RM 011 established Richard Mille's signature formula of a tonneau-shaped case housing a skeletonised automatic flyback chronograph movement. It became one of the brand's most recognisable and enduring references, produced across a wide range of case materials before being succeeded by the RM 11-03 in 2016.

RM 011.movement: Automatic · Richard Mille Calibre RMAC1 · variable-geometry rotor · flyback chronograph · ~50h power reserve
RM 011.materials: Available in titanium, 18k red/white gold, ceramic, Carbon TPT and Quartz TPT case constructions
RM 011.dial: Skeletonised dial exposing the movement architecture, with hours, minutes, small seconds, flyback chronograph, 60-minute countdown timer at 9 o'clock, 12-hour totaliser, oversize date and month indicator
RM 011.description: The RM 011 "Felipe Massa" is the automatic flyback chronograph that defined the modern Richard Mille silhouette: a tonneau case, curved bezel and fully skeletonised dial engineered in collaboration with the F1 driver whose name it carries. Its Calibre RMAC1 movement combines a variable-geometry rotor, flyback chronograph, countdown timer and annual calendar with month indicator into one open-worked architecture. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Automatic Flyback Chronograph: The core RM 011 execution — skeletonised dial, Calibre RMAC1 automatic flyback chronograph with countdown timer, 12-hour totaliser and month indicator, offered across titanium, gold, ceramic and Carbon TPT case options.
